case: P06/E04 DeepSeek × Chat Completions full and simple options: max_tokens, the thinking switch, reasoning_effort, tool choice, cache fields
source: Synthetic offline fixture. Chunk shapes follow DeepSeek's streamed Chat Completions (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion/ and the thinking mode guide https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode/, read 2026-10-02: reasoning_content deltas, usage with prompt_cache_hit_tokens/prompt_cache_miss_tokens and completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, finish_reason stop/length/content_filter/tool_calls/insufficient_system_resource, data: [DONE]) as consumed by pi-ai 0.87.1 (commit 898ab804050730e9dcefb4443875d5a932aa6a32) packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.ts through openai-node 6.40.0. Expected requests follow pi's buildParams and convertMessages for DeepSeek's detected compat (no store, no developer role, max_tokens, thinkingFormat deepseek, reasoning_content on assistant messages); the models are pi's deepseek.json openai-completions entries (ADR-0015). Error bodies follow DeepSeek's documented error codes (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/error_codes) in OpenAI's error object shape; their texts are illustrative. Costs are pi's calculateCost at the frozen prices of the model used.

scenarios.about: temperature and maxTokens: the budget goes out as max_tokens, never max_completion_tokens.
A null temperature is sent as null; maxTokens 0 sends nothing.
The full entry does not clamp: medium, null in the level map, goes out as medium with thinking on.
A model whose level map sets off to null (a custom model) sends no thinking field without a level.
A custom DeepSeek model without reasoning sends neither thinking nor reasoning_effort, whatever the level.
A named function choice is the function object form; tools carry strict false (DeepSeek's models support strict mode).
A session id with the default retention sends no prompt cache key off OpenAI's own API.
Long retention sends a derived prompt cache key (not the raw session id) and a 24h retention, as pi does for any compat that supports long retention.
samplingParams are applied last and override the named fields, the thinking switch included.
timeoutMs is announced as openai-node does.
minimal is unsupported on deepseek-flash and clamps up to low.
deepseek-v4-pro supports only high and max: low clamps up to high.
xhigh, unsupported, clamps to the nearest supported level.
The simple tool choice passes through beside a simple level: thinking with the automatic choice.
The simple entry's temperature and output budget.
